snippet.title: Car Wash Simulator - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
🚗 Wash cars to a shine and become the king of the car wash: https://store.steampowered.com/app/992840/Car_Wash_Simulator/

Check out Car Wash Simulator, arriving on PC in Early Access on August 10, 2026!

Become the owner of a car wash and grow it from a small operation into a thriving business. Wash and polish cars using a variety of tools and cleaning formulas, upgrade your equipment, and expand your infrastructure to attract new customers. Decide how you handle the competition and the gray market, and remember that every choice shapes your reputation.

#CarWashSimulator #Simulator #IndieGame
